dialect.detail: Appears to be a Brazilian ERP/web system (likely Totvs/RM or similar) using OO-COBOL extensions with INVOKE, object references, HTML preprocessing via htmlpp, and CGI form handling. Portuguese-language identifiers and Brazilian date/decimal conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian e-commerce/EFW401 order management system - altering transaction status for web orders (pedidos do site)
purpose.summary: This program manages the status of EFW401 e-commerce transactions. It allows users to change the generation status and situation of web orders (pedidos do site) either individually by order ID or in bulk by delivery date. It uses OO-COBOL with HTML preprocessing to render a CGI web interface.

notable_features: OO-COBOL INVOKE statements with object references
HTML preprocessing via EXEC HTML / END-EXEC (htmlpp)
CGI form input with EXTERNAL-FORM and IDENTIFIED BY clauses
$set compiler directives for preprocessor and free format
15 COPY statements for modular copybook structure
Object instantiation pattern: invoke EFW401 c-new
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but all four divisions are present. The dialect is ambiguous - the htmlpp preprocessor, OO-COBOL style, and naming conventions (PW prefix, EFW/PCW copybooks) suggest a Brazilian ERP platform, possibly Totvs Datasul or a similar system. The program_type is classified as online-cics as the closest match for a CGI/web interactive program, though it uses HTML preprocessing rather than CICS.
